verdict.rationale: HelixDB documents an official hosted MCP endpoint (https://mcp.helix-db.com/mcp) that exposes query, observability, and admin tools, including a permission-scoped `helix_execute_read_query` tool. `helix chef` also installs a docs MCP as part of agent setup, so an agent can connect through first-party MCP. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully, and evidence of a query MCP server for self-hosted or local instances (the documented endpoint is Helix Cloud only).
